rationale: A new full-card/panel display choice absent from v1.81.0: reveal user-hidden active devices as ordinary devices in every mode, without changing saved visibility. Not a fix for an intermediate release regression.

summary.ru: Показывайте скрытые устройства одним нажатием на глаз — с обычным светом, эффектами и управлением, без изменения сохранённых настроек.
summary.en: Reveal hidden devices with the header eye, keeping ordinary lighting, effects and controls without changing saved visibility.
